The archived RUN_A / RUN_B pipeline identities are exactly the governed ones

every LM history entry before the stop step records the LM's own strict decision on the journalled residuals (accepted is True exactly when objective(r_trial) < objective(r), as identification_step.run_bounded_lm; note exactly accepted / rejected; a trial objective exists) and the next entry follows it (accepted: the trial point, mu / mu_decrease, the next iteration; rejected: the same point, mu * mu_increase, the same iteration); otherwise JACOBIAN_INCONSISTENT. Red-probe (accepted=True relabelled note=rejected, identical Jacobian reconstruction) refused; reconstruct_lm_jacobian unchanged; no other tolerance
